mentions.name: PersonaStack
mentions.description: Cloud platform for AI teams that self-organize into any workflow. Automated stacks on the platform can run entirely on their own, such as one that has researched, authored, coded, shipped, and promoted a site for months, with other use cases like automatically identifying, fixing, and shipping fixes in response to 500 errors or running personal assistants. A catalog of easy-to-deploy stack templates is planned, and users can register for an invite.
